helpCenter.content:
What you need to know

This number will be applied to the employment agreement for contract purposes. For example, in case of employee termination.

Minimum days per year

By law, the employee is entitled to at least 20 days per year of paid time off. This then may/must be increased based on the following criteria:
 
  • Contributions to work (optional): the employee’s manager or director can increase the employee’s paid time off by 20 working days
  • Work experience (mandatory): 1 working day for every 10 years of work experience at the employer
  • Employee education type and level (mandatory): 1 working day for employees who have VII level of education

Do not include public or bank holidays

This field determines the number of paid time off days the employee gets as a benefit. These are sometimes called vacation or annual leave days. Each country has its own legal requirements for the number of paid time off days employees receive.

helpCenter.callToAction: Learn more about equity management at Remote
helpCenter.content:
Remote Equity is a lightweight compliance tool designed to help you manage equity grants across borders for team members hired through Remote's Employer of Record (EOR).

Whether you’re managing vesting, reporting exercises, or navigating local tax laws, Remote Equity gives you the structure to stay compliant, avoid risk, and support your team across borders.

Why it matters

As your EOR, Remote is legally responsible for equity-related tax and reporting in the countries where your team members are employed. That means we don’t just track equity, we:

  • Withhold and report taxes when required
  • File with local tax authorities
  • Support team members with clear guidance on their tax responsibilities

Most equity platforms can’t do that because they’re not the legal employer. Remote Equity ensures we have the data we need, when we need it, to keep your company compliant and your team fairly rewarded.

Behind the scenes, our tax team:

  • Handles tax withholdings when taxable events occur
  • Provides guidance to you and your team, even when no withholding is required
  • Manages additional reporting where local laws demand it

See also: What types of equity grants should I declare in Remote Equity?

What’s included

Remote Equity provides:

  • Tracking and alerts for events that may create a tax obligation (like vesting or exercising)
  • Automated compliance reminders based on local deadlines and regulations
  • Localized guidance for team members, shared through the Remote Equity app
  • Support from Remote’s tax and legal teams, who handle obligations on your behalf
  • Integration with Carta and Pulley to automatically sync grant declarations and exercise information

Get started in minutes

Setup takes less than five minutes. Just log in to your Remote account, and launch the Equity App to follow the setup steps.

Helpful guides to get started:

  • How can I access Remote Equity?
  • How do I declare a grant?
  • How can my team access their equity information?
  • What happens if I already declared equity before using Remote Equity?

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Who needs to use Remote Equity?

Any Remote customer granting equity to a team member hired through Remote’s EOR must use Remote Equity to meet local compliance requirements.

Why can’t we just use our own equity tool?

Traditional equity tools track grants and vesting, but they don't file taxes, withhold contributions, or report income to local authorities. Remote, as the legal employer, is responsible for these actions. Remote Equity ensures those obligations are covered.

What happens if we don’t use it?

If Remote doesn’t receive timely and accurate equity data, required filings may be missed. This can result in compliance risks, unexpected tax liabilities, and issues for both your company and your team members.

How much does Remote Equity cost?

Remote Equity costs 39 USD per month for each EOR team member with equity. Learn more.

For comprehensive information, visit the Remote Equity hub.
helpCenter.title: Welcome to Remote Equity: Global equity, without the compliance headaches

mandatory_expenses_to_be_paid.title: Mandatory expenses

helpCenter.callToAction: What do I need to know?
helpCenter.content:
I acknowledge that, if applicable, the employee is entitled to expense their employer for the following costs:

  • Commuting to and from work
  • Time spent on a business trip domestically
  • Time spent on a business trip abroad
  • Accommodation and meals while working outside the office'
  • Usage of paid time off entitlement'
  • Meals during work

In addition, the employee is entitled to separate compensation for work expenses incurred outside the business premises of the employer.

The amount of 1,000 RSD for meals during work is fixed and can be decreased only if the employee didn’t work for an entire month. The same can be applied to commuting expenses.

These amounts can be changed only by executing an annex to the employment agreement. In order for them to be unilaterally changed by the employer, they have to be stipulated either in the employment rulebook or through a separate decision by the employer.
helpCenter.title: Mandatory expenses (Serbia)

helpCenter.callToAction: What do I need to know?
helpCenter.content:
In case the employment agreement is terminated as above, the employee is entitled to a notice period whose duration depends on their total years of service:

  • 8 days, if they have up to 10 years of service
  • 15 days, if they have 10 to 20 years of service
  • 30 days, if they have more than 20 years of service

A notice period cannot be increased.

helpCenter.callToAction: What do I need to know?
helpCenter.content:
The employee is entitled to a total of 5 working days of paid time off in a calendar year, in case of getting married, spouse’s childbirth, and serious illness of immediate family member (spouse, children, brothers, sisters, parents, adoptive parents, adoptees, and guardians).

In addition, the employee is entitled to the following paid time off: 

  • 5 working days due to the death of an immediate family member (spouse, children, brothers, sisters, parents, adoptive parents, adoptees, and guardians)
  • 2 consecutive days for every instance of voluntary blood donation, counting also the day of blood donation.
helpCenter.title: Mandatory paid leave (Serbia)

rest_period_ack.title: Rest period

helpCenter.callToAction: What do I need to know?
helpCenter.content:
I acknowledge that the employee has a legal right to a rest period during the work day that cannot be used at the beginning or end of working hours:

  • 15 minutes if the employee works 4 to 6 hours per day
  • 30 minutes if the employee works more than 6 hours per day
  • 45 minutes if the employee works more than 10 hours per day

The employee is entitled to daily rest lasting at least 12 hours within a 24-hour period and weekly rest lasting at least 36 hours.
helpCenter.title: Rest period (Serbia)
